summary: mountainash-rules-babel is built on a protocol-based plugin architecture with entry-point discovery. Key maintenance areas include the registry and its plugin lifecycle, the DMN FEEL expression generator, the validator pipeline (including several stub validators ready for implementation), and the cross-package dependency on mountainash-rules for domain types.

concepts.name: Plugin Architecture
concepts.description: The registry discovers plugins via importlib.metadata entry point groups configured in pyproject.toml. Each plugin axis uses a @runtime_checkable Protocol, so new formats can be added by implementing the protocol and registering an entry point. The discover() method handles loading and caching.

concepts.name: Backlog: Known Issues
concepts.description: The backlog (docs/backlog.md) tracks known issues including BUG-001 (incorrect import path in coverage validator). Check the backlog before starting maintenance work to stay aware of known edge cases.

concepts.name: Stub Validators
concepts.description: Four validators (conflicts, coverage, orphans, round_trip) are registered as entry points but currently return 'not_implemented' findings. These are ready for implementation and are tracked as STUB-001 through STUB-004 in the backlog.

concepts.name: Design Considerations
concepts.description: The public API in __all__ includes compose() and round_trip(), which are forward-looking placeholders. The validate() function aggregates all validators including stubs. The registry handles load failures silently at DEBUG level. These design choices are tracked as RISK-001 through RISK-004 in the backlog for future refinement.

concepts.name: DMN FEEL Generation
concepts.description: The _feel_entry function maps all 11 MatchStrategy variants to FEEL expressions. When new match strategies are added to mountainash-rules, the FEEL mapping must be extended here to maintain complete DMN export coverage.

concepts.name: XML Security
concepts.description: A hardened XML parser module is available for use in future XML-based importers (e.g., DMN import). It provides protection against common XML attack vectors and is ready for integration when DMN import capabilities are added.

concepts.name: Cross-Package Dependencies
concepts.description: The package depends on mountainash-rules for all domain types (Lattice, Dimension, DimensionsMetadata, Aggregate, MatchStrategy). The test environment additionally requires mountainash-data, mountainash, and mountainash-settings. Keep these dependencies aligned when updating across the mountainash ecosystem.
